goodToKnow: Der Stalinismus is Stalinism, the totalitarian rule of Josef Stalin in the Soviet Union, with purges, show trials and the Gulag. In eastern Germany, Stalinist methods shaped the early GDR, including the crushing of the 17 June 1953 uprising. Die Entstalinisierung (de-Stalinisation) began after Khrushchev's 1956 speech. It has no plural.
